Chapter 7015: Celestial Source

Chapter 7015: Celestial Source

Ash-serpent didn’t seem like a special name. Alas, those aware of this immortal’s reputation shuddered.

Everyone knew Breaker Immortal to be the most brutal among the few primordial immortals in Heavenrealm. However, the most dreadful of them all might be Ash-serpent due to his state of existence.

If he didn’t restrain himself and let loose, his storm form would reduce worlds and all affinities to nothingness. This happened first in his original world.

Some said he was born as a human with a unique power, not a snake or a demon. This remained speculative.

During his birth, this particle power proved to be too much. His parents and an ancestral immortal suppressed his power, hoping he would become another immortal.

It didn’t take long before he surpassed his parents and seniors. Eventually, something caused him to release his power. Not even the immortal was spared.

Rumor has it he had a childhood sweetheart, the love of his life. As an adult, she wanted to leave him and their world. Was it due to fear of his power? Some also said it was because she wanted to join a powerful lineage elsewhere in Heavenrealm.

All in all, the emotional instability led to the particle eruption which buried his whole world. He became alone afterward.

With the help of his special gift, he later became a primordial immortal and started Vagabond Alliance. In his current realm, he had complete control over his particle power.

“Friend, you wish to fight?” The gray storm asked.

“I will kill you now.” Xiaolou Tingxue’s saber energy unleashed an invisible yet monstrous slash.

The storm released a particle to form a maelstrom, nullifying the slash. However, it couldn’t destroy it entirely.

“Xiaolou Tingxue lives up to his reputation.” An immortal commented on Tingxue having the upper hand in their first exchange.

“Brothers, harmony is the most precious thing.” Immortal Bronze spoke up.

“Buzz.” Suddenly, Heavencrush’s rays turned green and delved deeper into the ancestral ground.

This initiated a reflection of immortal rays throughout Dusk.

“Boom!” Next, eternal divine rings floated into the air and poured down an incredible power. It was as if a great immortal monarch was gracing everyone with his presence.

“The celestial stage.” All immortals became emotional; the weaker ones couldn’t stand straight.

“Buzz.” Heavencrush’s green rays disappeared immediately. Next, all the divine rings and visual phenomena also dispersed.

“The celestial source.” All eyes were on the ancestral ground.

“So it is right here, all that searching for nothing.” A brilliant immortal appeared in the air, capable of upholding the heavens and creating worlds with a single thought.

Others couldn’t help wanting to prostrate before him.

“Heaven’s Equal Immortal Monarch.” Someone said.

“Another primordial immortal.” Another added.

Just like that, four primordial immortals have arrived.
